spans.s:
धृष् धृष्णो॑ति ध॑र्षति pp. धृषित॑ & धृष्ट॑ q.v.
be bold, dare or venture to (inf.), defy (acc.). C. धर्षयति, pp.
धर्षित attack, injure, violate;
 M. overwhelm. — अप overwhelm,
conquer. अभि S. & C. the same. आ venture against, attack. C.
injure, offend. प्र venture against, assail, injure, harass. C. the
same + violate (a woman), destroy, lay waste. संप्र C. assail, defy.
प्रति hold out against, withstand. वि C. venture against, injure,
harass, also = seq. सम् C. violate (a woman), destroy. — Cf.
आधृ॑षे & धृष॑न्त्.

धृष्ट॑ a. bold, audacious;
 abstr. ˚ता† f., ˚त्व† n.
धृष्टद्युम्न m. N. of a prince.

धृष्णु॑ a. bold, courageous, valiant, strong, firm, n. adv.
— Abstr. ˚त्व† n.

धृष्णु॑षेण a. carrying a strong weapon or leading a
valiant army.
